steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Phew... It's getting late. Time to go home and sleep...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: This is a great place to run a seafood stand. I can't believe how many customers came through. Hm? Is that...?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll break this arm if I have to.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It's me, it's me! Let go!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Huh? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I just closed up. I'm on my way home.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You're the one who's here spacing out—— Well, I guess it's not spacing out if you can flip around and snap my neck like that...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Did you hear that car accident just now, up on the overpass?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...aren't you supposed to be studying?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: One must strike a balance between recreation and labor. If I spent the whole night before the exam cramming, I'd go in there with my brain totally fried.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, sure.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I heard some customers talking about it. I hope nobody died.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Same... but I heard something at the office. I guess there's some real unsavory characters mixed up in this...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Let's get this out of the way: I have nothing to do with any killers, gangs, or anyone in that world. You know that, right?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Everybody knows your deal—— Or maybe I should just say, with this attitude of yours, it's natural to be a little suspicious?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...right. I get it.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: And there was a gas explosion on a highway in the outskirts just two hours ago.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: A gas explosion on a highway? That's a pretty convenient explanation.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hey, you're not thinking...?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I told you: one must strike a balance between recreation and labor.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...right. I get it.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: So is this recreation or labor?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There we go. They can't do anything downtown like this. Too many people.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You ordered the matcha, right? This one's yours. My treat.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I don't see any mafia-looking guys, but... aren't we letting our guard down a bit too much?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What are you talking about? This place is a FIVE STAR recommendation. That's way more awesome than some mobsters.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You been able to contact Texas and them yet?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No, it was so fast...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So what's to be all nervous about?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Your ice cream's melting. You gotta calm down already.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Er, it's just... nobody could have predicted this. I should calm down.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: These mobsters came aaall the way from Siracusa to Lungmen. We can bet they're not here for Sauin, right?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...They definitely have some other goal. One of them is me, but beyond that, I don't know.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We're in a good position. We managed to lose them. And with just the two of us versus however many of them, we have the advantage in scouting them out...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But how do we proceed? Should we start hunting them? No, the better move is to reconnect with Texas...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh. You seem a lot more like an ordinary Messenger than Texas and the girls.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, sorry, was I talking to myself?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No, you're right.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We know the mob is up to something, we can't just go off half cocked.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But sometimes you gotta trust in the girls. I know they can be a little out there, but Penguin Logistics is a tough cookie.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's kind of weird to call a logistics firm 'tough,' but... Forget it. It's not like I've got any room to complain.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Let's just take a walk, enjoy the scenery. And maybe by the time we run into Texas and the crew, they'll have this whole gang war all wrapped up?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...erm, really?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You see that candy store?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's really more of a stall than a store.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm, it is pretty old.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I came here on a trip to Lungmen years ago.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Back then... I didn't have any Lungmen dollars on me. Honestly, I must've looked a sight. But still, I found myself drawn to the candy.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: O... kay.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's what a Messenger does. We get into trouble on our long and arduous journeys.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: C'mon, let's take a look.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Wow! It's a twinkly star!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Mister, how did you pull a star down here?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Sorry, but that's a secret I'll have to keep.

steps.name: Little Boy
steps.text: That's not a star! It's just a candy with some food coloring!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: But I've never seen such a pretty candy before... you sure you don't want one?

steps.name: Little Boy
steps.text: Y- you're such a pain! Don't they have any cotton candy?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Of course we do. Here, give me your hand.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Oh... but I don't want cotton candy. I want that one...

steps.name: Little Boy
steps.text: I hate fruity candies! They're too sweet! And they turn your tongue weird colors!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Just take what you want. No charge. For Sauin.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Now it's getting late. You kids hurry home and get to bed!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Thanks, mister!

steps.name: Little Boy
steps.text: Hurry up! I wanna go to the toy store and check out the limited Sauin knights they got!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Kids these days have so much energy.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Did you want something? We've got these lovely Victorian gumdrops. Real imports. And they come with a candle for Sauin.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We're in no hurry. The night is young.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Ho ho. And so are you. You two must be here for the downtown Carnival.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Mostima, who is this guy...?)

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...you enjoy the nightlife, sir?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Not with these old bones I don't. But the candy I sell tends to make its way there for me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Is there something special about this year's Carnival Gala? Looks like a lot of foreign guests in town.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Things have been quiet in this town for too many years. The people are definitely itching for the Carnival.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: The Carnival brings in all kinds of characters showing up getting into all kinds of trouble. And that's pretty fun, isn't it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, for sure.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: The point of Sauin was always to see off the souls of the departed. If the living are having a good time, that's a decent sacrifice.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: You really don't want anything? Last time, you stood outside with your face stuck to the display window. I thought I was gonna have to peel you off.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wow, you remember me? That's kind of embarrassing.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hah. How could I forget?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'd love to. But I really can't be eating too many sweets before work.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: That's too bad... Ah well, have a good evening, kids.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Do come again, when you have time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah. Of course.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The Carnival, huh? I heard it's the biggest festival event for Lungmen in years.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ......Bison?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sorry, I just had something on my mind...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's pretty obvious what you'd be thinking about at a time like this.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But boy do you love thinking too much. Just go with your gut sometimes.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: My gut... even a Messenger like you says to trust your gut?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You play it case by case. Like right now we're up here on a bridge, and there's a cargo ship passing down below us.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Okay?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And we got three disguised mobsters coming at us from both directions.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Wha!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's too late now. They've been watching us for a while.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Since the candy store.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We- we're surrounded?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's tourists all around us, so we can't fight.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But I'm not sure these guys have any hangups about that.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...so what do we do?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Jump.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm sorry?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Jump. Now.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Off the bridge——?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There you go with that thinking again. Hop over the railing. Take a leap of faith. Like so——!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: W- wait a sec——

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Welp! Somehow I feel like this isn't my first time in freefall....

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's... candy? Why is this freighter hauling candy?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But at least it looks like we lost them, Mostima——

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima?
